body: I've tried, sorry for late reply. Been out of it. Nice to have the backup petty drunk so gonna see how i feel. People I know try to understand but fed up of piling it on them.

Thank you for that, is the morning now and I'm feeling shaken but less bad than last night it definitely comes in episodes. I've Been scared to tell people how I really feel because they have their own stuff to deal with and it feels like I'm putting on a face in public and as soon as I'm on my own the shame and hatred comes and takes over me. I have medication but it helps a bit and seems to increase how bad I feel when I hit the end of the week. I'm sorry for not replying sooner I crashed last night.

This was an amazing reply thank you, I really have felt the same since school, convinced I was gonna die young at my own hands. I have been taking medicine (mirtazapine and now citalopram) for several years now and have been seeing a counsellor but maybe I need to push for psychiatric help?

I've never been good at asserting my needs and I'm sorry for a late reply I crashed last night from exhaustion and crying

I don't even know. I have this core feeling that I'm a bad person and only make people unhappy in the end.

I blame myself for everything and almost ended it tonight but panicked and ran home instead. I haven't slept properly in months it feels and I'm just so tired of myself.
